issues.description: The template declares Course.ratings as a mutable property (var ratings: [Int]) with default (module) visibility, while the solution makes ratings private (private var ratings: [Int]). The problem statement mentions the existence of a ratings property but does not specify visibility. This visibility difference between template and solution is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about whether ratings should be externally accessible or encapsulated.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility explicit in the problem statement (e.g. state whether ratings should be publicly accessible or encapsulated). Then align the template with that intent: either declare ratings with the appropriate access level (e.g. make it private if encapsulation is intended) or keep it non-private in both template and solution if external access is expected.
